answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 9 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The thread multiplier is published, charged in violet, and summit lists each payment. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 4435 identities would post 516 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
